exact_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: canonical supporting fictional-adult character continuity sheet for an original webtoon, owner-review-pending
Input images: Image 1 is the registered style-system anchor created in this experiment; preserve its original Tarin identity, palette, contour, and rendering.
Primary request: Create one clean portrait reference sheet divided into exactly three stacked full-body-to-knee frames on a neutral pale blue-gray background.
Frame 1: Tarin Kest, fictional adult man age 45, broad mature build, deep umber skin, short tightly curled black hair silver at both temples, pearl-gray practical warden coat over muted teal, dark trousers and boots, holding a long ivory spear-key; restrained steady expression.
Frame 2: Kesin Or, fictional adult nonbinary archivist age 52, compact mature build, light olive skin, shaved head, round amber spectacles, plum-gray layered archive jacket, ink-dark gloves and satchel; alert analytical expression.
Frame 3: Serac Dain, fictional adult man age 51, lean mature build, pale bronze skin, swept-back charcoal hair with one white central streak, immaculate ivory magistrate coat with restrained black geometry and mirrored oath gauntlet; controlled severe expression.
Style: original clean cinematic fantasy-webtoon, crisp dark-navy contours, limited interior lines, smooth restrained cel shading, pearl/midnight support and selective cyan-gold accent.
Composition: one adult per frame, unmistakable silhouettes, large readable face and hands, no labels.
Constraints: practical non-sexualized clothing; no text, letters, numbers, boxes, balloons, logos, signatures, watermarks; no children or young-looking adults; no real-person likeness; no third-party design; no named-style imitation.
Avoid: woodcut, hatching, paper grain, grunge, clutter, multiple effects, glossy 3D.
